The [[Nightfallen Garden]] is an example of what the [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall event]] will do to the land should it come to pass fully. After the events in the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] mission, the [[Garden of Seborhin]] becomes inaccessible and is replaced by the Nightfallen Garden. The terrain and scenery reflects the [[Realm of Torment]].

==Getting there==
Completion of [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] opens access to this area, but only until the completion of [[Abaddon's Gate]].

It is possible to retain access to this area ''and'' the Garden of Seborhin after the completion of Abaddon's Gate. It can be done by acquiring but ''not'' completing the [[primary quest]] [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]], since that quest leads here. The downside is that you will not be able to acquire the [[Protector]] and [[Guardian (title)|Guardian of Elona]] titles, as you must complete the quest to gain access to [[Jennur's Horde]].

==Notes==
*This location is considered "underground" (i.e. not shown on the [[world map]]), and as such, it does not contribute towards the [[Cartographer]] title track.
*It is possible to retain access to both this area and the Garden of Seborhin. See the "Getting there" section above.
**Unlike Garden of Seborhin, entry into the Nightfallen Garden does not require talking to [[Seborhin Protector Zuor]] (i.e. your [[character]] can go through the Nightfallen Garden [[portal]]).
*Weapons normally found in [[the Fissure of Woe]] have a small chance of dropping from the creatures here.
*This is an excellent place to [[Lightbringer_rank#Acquisition|earn Lightbringer points]] early. Use the map to acquire the necessary [[bounty|bounties]]. Try to avoid as much fighting as possible prior to that.
*Several Margonite groups are known to sometimes attack other groups.
*This area contains [[Margonite Chest]]s instead of [[Vabbian Chest]]s. However, you can't buy a [[Margonite Key]] in nearby outposts, they can be bought only in outposts belonging to [[Realm of Torment]].
